about: Corporate actions on candidate ETFs, each with the documents that support it. A verified action's units multiplier and dates are stated in an official document; they are never derived from a price change, which is only checked against them. Unverified actions are leads: they resolve nothing. On the BSE files checked, PREVCLOSE was not restated on split ex-dates, so price files alone cannot confirm a split.
